questions.question: Centripetal force 'F' required for circular motion of an object of mass 'm' moving in circle of radius 'r' at a tangential velocity 'v' is equal to _______
questions.solution:
__EXPLANATION__:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a6eca6b0f414fa82cb491266a1a08651a3b085e6bc2521687e9341b7aa8334f.png] 

__
 
• When a particle is revolving in a circular path, the centripetal force acts on the particle towards the center of the circular path and is represented by

​Rightarrow F_c=(mv²)/(r)

​Where F is the centripetal force, m is the mass of the particle, v is velocity, and r is the radius.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Centripetal acceleration: The acceleration is directed radially toward the center of the circle and has a magnitude equal to the square of the body's velocity along the curve divided by the radius of the circular path.

Rightarrow a_c=(V²)/(r)

Where a is centripetal acceleration, V = velocity of the particle, r = radius of the circle.

5c

questions.concept: India under East India Company’s Rule
questions.question: The ______ was an Act of the Parliament of Great Britain intended to overhaul the management of the East India Company's rule in India.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Regulation Act 1773.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Regulating Act of 1773 was **an Act of the Parliament of Great Britain intended to overhaul the management of the East India Company's rule in India. **The Regulating Act introduced by Frederick North, on 18 May 1773.** This act was passed due to the misgovernment by the British East India government that introduced a situation of bankruptcy.
 
• **Regulating Act of 1773 **was the first step taken** **by the British Government** ****to control and regulate the affairs of East India Company in India.** It was established for Parliamentary control over the administration of the East India Company.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Pitt’s India Act 1784,** named for the British prime minister William Pitt the Younger, established the dual system of control by the British government and the East India Company, Pitt”s India act set up a board of control in Britain which the British government could fully control the company's civil, military and revenue affairs in India.
 
• **The Government of India Act 1858 **was an Act of the British parliament that transferred the government and territories of the East India Company to the British Crown. The government of India Act was passed directly to the British government. 
 
• After the War of Independence, Sir Syed Ahmed Khan advised the British Government to take Indian nationals into the administration of India. **The Indian council act passed in 1861. **
tags: India under East India Company’s Rule

questions.question: Which city is NOT situated on the Banks of the Chambal River?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jabalpur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jabalpur is not situated on the banks of the Chambal River. **Jabalpur is a city in the state of Madhya Pradesh. It is known for the Dhaundhar Falls. **Jabalpur is one of the 100 smart cities in India.
 
• Kota, Gwalior, and Dholpur are situated on the banks of the Chambal River.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****

 
• Chambal river is one of the cleanest perennials rivers of India. **It originates at Janapav South of Mhow town in the Vindhaya mountain range.** The length of the Chambal River is **960 Kms.**
 
• **There are four main dams on the Chambal River : **

 
• **Gandhi Sagar Dam:** The Gandhi Sagar Dam is situated **on the boundary of Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan.** The dam may be a 64 meter tall stonework gravity dam, with a existing storage facility of 6,920 Mm³ and a catchment area area of 22,584 km², of which merely 1,537 km² is situated in Rajasthan.
 
• **Rana Pratap Sagar Dam**: Rana Pratap Sagar Dam is situated** on Rawatbhata in the district of Chittorgarh, Rajasthan. ** The overall drainage basin of this dam is 24,864 km².
 
• **Jawahar Sagar Dam**: Jawahar Sagar Dam is situated **26 km downstream of Rana Pratap Sagar Dam and 29 km upstream of Kota city.** The overall drainage basin of the Jawahar Sagar Dam is 27,195 km².
 
• **Kota Barrage Dam** : Kota Barrage Dam is situated **around 0.8 km upstream of Kota City in Rajasthan.** The overall drainage basin of Kota Barrage is 27,332 km².

questions.question: The fundamental rights of citizens are embodied in which part of the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
**The fundamental rights of the citizens are embroidered in the part-III of the Indian Constitution**. These are the **right to equality **(law prohibition of discrimination on Grounds on religion race caste sex), the r**ight to freedom of speech and expression, the right against exploitation, the right to freedom of religion, the right to constitutional remedies, and the right to freedom of education.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1 - **The Union and its territories India has **28 states and 8 union territories **. Part-I is the compilation of the laws pertaining to the constitution of India. This part of the constitution contains the law in the establishment renaming merging or altering the border of States.

questions.question: Fundamental duties in the Indian constitution are borrowed from the constitution of _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**USSR.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fundamental Duties in the Indian constitution are borrowed from the constitution of the USSR**. USSR is known as the Constitution of** the Soviet Union. **The Union of Soviet Socialist Republics was a federal socialist state in Northern Eurasia that **existed from 1922 to 1991.**
 
• **Indian constitution borrowed fundamental duties and the ideal of justice (social, economic, and political) in the preamble from the USSR. **Many other ideas were borrowed from South Africa, Japan, and France.
 
• **Some of the features are borrowed from the USA :**

 
• **Fundamental Rights:** Articles 12 to 35 of the Indian constitution contains all fundamental rights. Fundamental rights are basic human rights. **There are six fundamental rights: ** Right to equality, Right to Freedom, Right to Freedom of Religion, Right against Exploitation, Right to Constitutional Remedies, and Cultural and Educational Rights.
 
• **Judicial review: **It is a type of court case, in which someone challenges the lawfulness of a government decision. Otherwise, the court can order the government to do or not do something. The law which applies in cases of this type is sometimes called “public law” or “administrative law”.
